name: Calendar Card
description: A tactile calendar with animated date selection, event dots, hover event popups and an optional event creation form.
summary: Select dates and browse months or years. Hover, focus or tap a marked date for event details, and use the optional add form to schedule events and assign them to a name or team.
highlights: Raised charcoal card with coral accents
Clamped month navigation preserves the day where possible
Horizontal layout in wide containers, compact stacked layout on mobile
Rolling day transitions and independent counter animation for changing year digits
Translucent date hover highlight glides between cells without changing selection
Optional event click callback for opening event details
Customizable accent, comfortable or compact spacing, and Monday or Sunday week start
Event details in an animated popup on hover, keyboard focus or tap
Optional event form with date, time, color and assignee fields
Events remain owned by the caller through events and onEventAdd props

accessibility.aria: Labeled date buttons expose selection and event counts. Marked dates expose an event popup. The add form uses an accessible modal with labeled fields and focus restoration.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Animations are disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

keyboard.description: Select the adjacent day or week.
Select the same day in the previous or next month, clamped to the last day.
Select the first or last day of the month.
Close the event popup or month picker. Escape also closes the add-event modal.
Focusing a marked date opens its details. Tab into the popup to interact with events or add another event.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date, using local calendar days.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a date is selected or month navigation changes the selection.

props.name: events
props.description: Events with a unique id, local YYYY-MM-DD date, title, optional time label, CSS color and assignee. Up to three dots per date; its popup lists all events in input order.

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Makes popup event entries clickable and receives the clicked event.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: CSS accent color for selection, progress, focus rings and uncolored events. Use a light accent with sufficient contrast against the dark selected-date text.

props.name: density
props.description: Spacing of date cells. The selection and hover highlights follow the cell size.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First weekday: 0 for Sunday or 1 for Monday.

props.name: showEvents
props.description: Enables event detail popups on hover, focus or tap. Date dots remain visible when disabled.

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Shows segmented progress through the selected month.

props.name: onEventAdd
props.description: Enables the Add event form and receives the new event with a generated id. Append it to your events state or persist it in your app. The form includes an optional assignee name or team; it does not send invitations.
